_comment: TASK-118 batch c7 (Android capability probe). It measures what this machine can actually do with the three Android tools, so the register can say 'needs an external device' with command-level evidence instead of an assumption. Measured BEFORE the run, from cmd: `where adb` -> exit 1 (not on PATH); `C:\Program Files (x86)\Android\android-sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe version` -> Android Debug Bridge 1.0.41 / 36.0.0-13206524; `adb devices -l` -> 'List of devices attached' with an EMPTY list; `set | findstr ANDROID` -> only JAVA_HOME; and grep over every projects/**/export_presets.cfg finds no platform="Android" preset in this repo. The run therefore prepends the SDK platform-tools to THIS PROCESS' PATH (nothing machine-wide) so `adb` is resolvable, and records: the real empty device list, the preset-info answer for a project with no Android preset, and the deploy refusals (skip_export=true keeps the export child process out of it).

calls.note: os_list_android_devices call 1/5: measures the machine (adb on PATH for this process only, no device attached)
boundary: the contract declares an empty object schema, so any argument is refused
project_get_android_preset_info call 1/5: this project has no Android preset (only Windows Desktop)
boundary: a preset name that does not exist
os_deploy_to_android_device boundary 1/5: no such preset; skip_export keeps the export child process out of it
os_deploy_to_android_device boundary 5/5 (no Android export template is installed anyway: %APPDATA%\Godot\export_templates holds 4.8.dev Windows templates only)
